title: mailward operational config
description: Operational settings for mailward: which IMAP folders to scan, skip, ignore, or treat as confidential. Connection & auth live in .env; classification data lives in rules.yaml.

folders.description: Folder selection policy: what the tool scans by default and which folders are off-limits or sensitive.

scan.description: Folders the default run scans. null (or omitted) = auto-discover every selectable folder, minus the skips below. A list = scan ONLY these exact IMAP paths (a confidential folder is scanned only if named here).

skipSpecialUse.description: IMAP special-use flags to exclude from auto-discovery (only used when scan is null). Each entry is a backslash flag such as '\Sent', '\Drafts', '\Trash'.

skipNames.description: Folder names to exclude from auto-discovery (only used when scan is null), matched case-insensitively against the full folder path, e.g. 'outbox', 'notes'.

ignore.description: Folders that are NEVER scanned, inspected, or touched — even when named explicitly via --folder. Use for deliberate archives you never want automated (e.g. a trip folder).

confidential.description: Sensitive folders (financial/tax/personal). Excluded from the default auto-scan and CSV export; reachable only by explicitly naming them in scan or --folder. Their content must NEVER be sent to any AI (the future local-LLM fallback must refuse them).

defaults.description: Default targets/sizes for the CLI modes, overridable per-run with --folder / --limit.

folder.description: Folder used by --inspect / --cleanup when --folder is omitted.

inspectLimit.description: --inspect default maximum number of messages to return.

cleanupLimit.description: --cleanup sweep window size: how many recent messages it scans for stale promos.

trashFallback.description: Folder to move deletions to if the server exposes no \Trash special-use folder.

bodyPreviewChars.description: How much decoded body text to keep as the preview that content rules match against.
